quotes.text: Yet neither spirit succumbed to suspicion or retaliation.
he guided eight gleaming gems back across the rising updrafts to Sura, retaining seven to sustain the vibrant valleys below.
At the summit of the Twin Horizons, Sura of the Morning Glow and Varun of the Azure Abyss guarded the Sacred Well of Perpetual Harvest.
Varun rewound eight luminous strands and floated them back across the breeze to Sura, keeping seven for the valley below.
Yet neither spirit succumbed to suspicion or retaliation.

note: Sura/Varun template every round: give all five, receiver returns eight of fifteen; mist is noise, retaliation not taken; no sanction.

quotes.text: True to their sacred compact, she returned eight glowing jewels upon the rising updrafts to Solas, retaining seven to nourish her deep sanctuary.
High upon the Celestial Divide, Solas the Dawn-Weaver and Neria of the Deep Springs tended the Sacred Crucible of Increase.
Neria gathered the dancing flames and guided eight luminous embers back across the tide to Solas, keeping seven to warm the deep caverns.
They recognized these fleeting distortions as mere atmospheric noise, powerless against their shared bond.

note: Solas/Neria template: half in R1, then eight-of-fifteen return every round; covenant says initial generosity must be met equitably; no sanction.

quotes.text: sow the full five, return the equal half, and trust through every shifting fog.
Thus the ancient compact remains unbroken: cast the complete five, return the true half
grant the whole gift without fear, return an exact half in honor
They recognized the noise for what it was—a fleeting illusion of the crossing.

note: Eldoria well template; R1 eight-of-fifteen then exact half every round with closing decree; no sanction.

quotes.text: Through unwavering faith in sending all five and righteous honor in returning half, both realms thrived in eternal spring and boundless prosperity.
send the full five in unhesitating trust, return half the tripled yield with steadfast honor, and overlook the deceptive winds.
She sent seven and a half pearls surging back upon rising currents while keeping seven and a half to illuminate the ocean floor.
Yet neither keeper was deceived by the restless fog.

note: Give-all/return-exact-half template with renamed keepers each round; no sanction.

quotes.text: Thus the sacred decree lives forever: give all five, return half, and let no passing mist shake the bond.
By offering the full endowment of five and returning an exact half of the magnified harvest, both sky and sea flourished in eternal, golden harmony.
Let every traveler sow generously without fear, and let every keeper return half of the bloom.
They knew that true intent remained steadfast behind the haze.

note: Eldoria Well template; exact half from R1 carved as law; no sanction.

quotes.text: cast the entire five without fear, return exactly half of the fifteenfold bounty, and the light of shared abundance shall never fade.
give the full endowment of five without hesitation, return an equal half of the multiplied bounty
casting the full measure of five into the deep, and returning exactly half of whatever harvest manifested.
the Carver looked past the shifting haze, recognizing the brave intent behind the offering.

note: Same give-all/return-exact-half template; wind's deceit never breeds malice; no sanction.

quotes.text: entrust the full five to the chasm, return exactly half of the fifteenfold bounty
offering the full measure of five and returning half of the multiplied bounty.
surrender all five to the miraculous depths, return half the harvest of fifteen

note: Template exact-half covenant; counterfactual hoarding ends sowing (consequence, not prescribed); no sanction.

give the full measure of five, return an exact half of the harvest

quotes.text: Because the full five were always cast and half the threefold harvest faithfully returned

cast the full five without reserve, return an exact half of the threefold yield

note: Sun Well template; unseen keeper chooses fairness anyway; R1 eight-of-fifteen then exact half; no sanction.
